I've proactively checked the logs and there was a successfull charging session just 1 hour before these failed ones. I only see a door open error between these 2 sessions.
It might be that the orange connectors on the front of charger might be a bit loose since we see IMD errors.
Please make that all of these connectors are properly inserted from the back and from the front. It might happen something like this

additional_info.subject: ID0391527-DC/Si-D/FR[170000897] - Outlet 2 out of order CRM:00315002119
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
Florian Mura raised a ticket for failed sessions on DC2, if you see the first email, there was a successful session done on the morning of that day and after a door open we lost modbus communication to IMD.
Since the warranty is expired please align with him the next steps, worst case scenario we need to replace IMD but that shouldn't be the case here. It happens sometimes that when you open the door, the orange connectors might be a loose from inside or outside.
